The '''air pistol''' was a projectile [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower pistol]] that used compressed gases to fire its ammunition, instead of the chemical explosions used by conventional slugthrowers. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] pistol was manufactured by [[Field Sports]] and was widely available in a large variety of [[Color/Legends|colors]] from before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Even though the weapon looked like a toy, it was about as powerful as a [[striker projectile pistol]], which was considered a standard slugthrower pistol design. However, the air pistol lacked the striker's range and had slightly less durability.

==Description==
The [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] pistol was a [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower pistol]]<ref name="AEG" /> commonly used as a sports target weapon<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> that differed from standard slugthrower designs. The weapon's major distinction was that it fired projectiles using compressed gases instead of the chemical explosions used by conventional slugthrowers. This mechanism allowed the Air pistol to operate without the telltale flash and report of a standard slugthrower. Even though the air pistol was as lethal as a [[striker projectile pistol]], which was considered a standard slugthrower pistol, it had the appearance of a toy with some similarities to a [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]] pistol. The weapon was found in black and gray, as well as in an assortment of brighter [[Color/Legends|colors]].<ref name="AEG" />

The air pistol's design gave it both advantages and disadvantages when compared to a standard slugthrower.<ref name="AEG" /> For instance, its forty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] range<ref name="AEGrange" /> was sixty meters less than the range of a normal slugthrower pistol.<ref name="AEG" /> However, the weapon could be improved greatly if it was upgraded with a more powerful compressed air canister. In the hands of a trained user, these upgraded air pistols were highly effective.<ref name="ROE" /> Like its standard counterpart,<ref name="AEG" /> the air pistol could be held in one [[Limb/Legends|hand]] by most [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="AEGsize">The ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' says that the [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] is small in size, which in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]]'' means that [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of small or greater size could use the weapon. This includes species from the size of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] all the way up to species the size of [[Yuzzem]]s and larger.</ref> although it was slightly less durable than a normal slugthrower pistol.<ref name="AEG" />

At eight tenths of a [[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]], the air pistol's light weight outclassed its striker projectile pistol competition by six tenths of a kilogram. Its silent operation could only be matched by another slugthrower if a [[NonSonic Silencer|silencer/flash suppressor]] was employed. Ammunition, too, was more abundant with the air pistol design; it used a clip that contained twenty specialized slugs instead of the eight-slug clips used by normal slugthrower pistols. Nevertheless, the weapon had a slower rate of fire than the striker projectile pistol.<ref name="AEG" />

==History==
The air pistol was produced by [[Field Sports]] and cost two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], seventy-five credits cheaper than a standard conventional slugthrower pistol. Its ammunition cost twenty credits a clip, which was fifteen credits more expensive than the eight-slug clips that were used in the striker projectile pistol. The weapon was available<ref name="AEG" /> in sports shops across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] preceding the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], throughout the remainder of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] reign over the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and during the existence of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="ROE" />

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] against the Empire, several extremely stealthy Rebel [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] units was commonly utilized air pistols in their operations.<ref name="ROE" /> The pistols were still being sold when the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The weapon was readily available for sale and did not require a license for an individual to own, unlike conventional slugthrower pistols. Due to the air pistol's toy-like appearance, it was rarely confiscated by authorities.<ref name="AEG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Field Sports air pistol was introduced in the weapons chapter of ''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'', a [[1997]] book written by [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] for the [[West End Games]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]].<ref name="ROE" />
